profileEvidence.summary: Gentle and affectionate, the Ruby King Charles Spaniel is a happy toy companion that can be reserved rather than immediately outgoing. Its royal name was retained at King Edward VII’s urging. In 1945 the Kennel Club separated King Charles and Cavalier spaniels, keeping this compact toy branch distinct; Ruby is one of its four maintained colours.
profileEvidence.shortDescription: A gentle, affectionate royal toy spaniel with a reserved streak; Ruby is one of four maintained colours.
